data.location: 2116 New Bern Ave., Suite J, Raleigh, NC 27610
data.status: targeting an opening in the next two to four weeks
data.short_description: All Kinds is a new local craft shop offering artisan goods, pottery, beer and wine, opening next to Little Blue Bakehouse in Raleigh. The space will allow customers to shop local crafts while enjoying a glass of wine or beer. It will not operate as a restaurant but may offer grab-and-go snacks.

data.location: 34 Webb St Suite 201, Roswell, GA 30075
data.status: targeting an opening in the next one to two months
data.short_description: Chucho is a Mexican churro and chocolate brand launching its first U.S. location in Downtown Roswell's Webb Collective. The shop will offer customizable made-to-order churros with fillings, toppings, and coverings, along with hot and cold chocolate-based beverages. The brand started in Mexico in 2018 and currently has eight stores there.

data.location: 10593 Ulmerton Road, Largo, FL 33771
data.short_description: Two Daughters Bagels is opening a New York-style bagel shop in the Largo Retail Shoppes plaza in a 2,100-square-foot former mobility store. The shop will handmake bagels daily using cold fermentation, high-heat baking, and a reverse osmosis water system engineered to replicate New York City water quality. The menu will include approximately 15 bagel varieties, a lox program, and coffee through a partnership with Buddy Brew Coffee.

data.location: 2800 South Rio Grande Ave., Orlando, FL 32805
data.status: opening date to be announced pending regulatory approval
data.short_description: Laplies Caribbean Eatz is a takeout-focused restaurant serving Haitian, Caribbean and American-style food in Orlando. The restaurant will not have indoor seating and is waiting for DBPR approval before opening. Menu highlights include fried chicken wings, french fries and griot, a Haitian dish with fried meat, fried plantains and sauce.

data.location: 7112 N. Florida Ave., Unit 7118, Tampa, FL 33604
data.status: targeting a late June or July 1st opening
data.short_description: Corner Haus is a creative co-op space in Tampa housing a flower shop, coffee and matcha cart, photography studio, fitness studio, retail market and event rental space across 1,800 square feet. The space is co-owned by Gabbie Welvaert of Wall Flower Events & Co. and Gabbie Mondejar of Sage Coterie. A third vendor, Flour My Day, will operate a mobile coffee and matcha cart inside the space.

data.location: 125 E. Main Ave., Gastonia, NC 28052
data.short_description: Piedmont Delicatessen is a daytime deli with a hidden evening speakeasy opening in a historic downtown Gastonia building. The concept was inspired by a preserved ghost mural advertising Piedmont cigarettes from the early 1900s discovered during renovation. The opening menu will feature four signature sandwiches with build-your-own options, plus a connection to the history of Piedmont cigarettes and early baseball trading cards.

data.location: 4941 Dogwood Blvd., Kannapolis, NC 28081
data.status: targeting a late August or early September opening
data.short_description: Burrito Shak is opening a beach-inspired fast-casual franchise location in the new Kellswater Commons shopping center in Kannapolis, operated by franchisees Mike and Christine Gracer. The restaurant will offer burritos, burrito bowls, tacos, chips, queso and drinks in a walk-through ordering format similar to Chipotle. Construction is expected to begin within about 30 days of receiving the keys, with a 90-day buildout anticipated.

data.location: 2831 E Commercial Blvd, Fort Lauderdale, FL 33308
data.short_description: Essenza Italian Eatery & Market is a full-service Italian restaurant and market opening on owner Maria Avallone's 40th birthday in Fort Lauderdale. The restaurant will offer 94 seats, fresh homemade pasta, focaccia, gelato, a bakery, a bar and a market component with staff from Italy including team members from Tuscany and Naples. The concept also incorporates Avallone's tiramisu brand, Passion Tiramisu, with more than 20 flavors available.

data.location: 34 Powder Springs St SW, Marietta, GA 30064
data.short_description: Antika is a woman-owned Mediterranean small plates restaurant with craft cocktails and wine opening in Marietta, pending final state liquor license approval. The restaurant will seat approximately 35 to 40 guests inside, with a patio featuring a city-painted mural, a historic magnolia tree and planned live music. The menu draws from Spanish, Italian and Greek Mediterranean influences.

data.location: 75 John Wesley Dobbs Ave. NE, Atlanta, GA 30303
data.status: soft open June 1st, followed by a launch on June 10th
data.short_description: Urban Tea Party is a tea lounge, retail shop, tasting room and cultural event space opening in Studio House in Atlanta's Sweet Auburn district. The concept will offer more than 100 tea SKUs, tea flights and pairings, food presented in a tea tower style, and a separate climate-controlled tasting room seating 12 for private events. The larger Studio House space can accommodate events with up to 200 guests.

data.location: 11650 Johns Creek Pkwy, Johns Creek, GA 30097
data.short_description: CT Cantina & Taqueria is opening its sixth location at Medley in Johns Creek, with seating for approximately 100 to 125 guests. The restaurant will offer its standard authentic Mexican cuisine menu, with the main distinction being a location-specific interior design. A tentative feature includes an ordering window facing a green space for margaritas and other drinks.

data.location: 5470 7th St., Zephyrhills, FL 33542
data.short_description: Trattoria Napoli is a full-service neighborhood Italian restaurant targeting a July 23 opening in Zephyrhills, contingent on construction, licensing and certificate of occupancy. The restaurant will seat approximately 120 guests across a main dining room, pizza room, bar and outdoor seating. The menu will center on handmade pasta, pizza from a gas-fired Wood Stone oven, fresh seafood and steaks.

data.location: 8420 N. Lockwood Ridge Road, Sarasota, FL 34243
data.short_description: Melt is a locally owned upscale fast-casual smash burger restaurant from the Alnadi family targeting a July 15 soft opening and August 15 grand opening in Sarasota. The 1,600-square-foot space will seat about 35 guests inside with two outdoor tables, an exposed kitchen, ordering kiosks and murals referencing local Sarasota landmarks. The menu will focus on smash burgers, fries and shakes with made-to-order items and rotating limited-time specials.

data.location: 204 NE 1st St., Miami, FL 33132
data.status: targeting an opening by the end of next week
data.short_description: Picanha 305 Brazilian Steakhouse is opening in the former Sparky's Barbecue space in downtown Miami, owned by Valter Guida and his wife Carol Li. The restaurant will feature a salad bar, grilled meats cut to order by weight, and approximately 50 seats. Beverages will include beer, wine and sakérinhas, a sake-based version of a caipirinha.

data.location: 5537 Palmer Crossing Circle, Sarasota, FL 34233
data.status: targeting an early to mid-July opening
data.short_description: JavaCone is a family-owned fast-casual coffee, pastry, lunch and ice cream shop with about 34 seats opening in the Palmer Crossing Shopping Center in Sarasota. The menu will include espresso drinks, cold brew, refresher-style drinks, pastries, breakfast sandwiches, vegan and vegetarian options and scratch-made frittatas. The dessert program will feature premium ice cream with scratch-made skillet cookies and toppings.

data.location: 2519 Fairview Road, Raleigh, NC 27608
data.status: targeting an opening in the first week of November
data.short_description: La Victoria Raleigh is a full-service elevated Mexican restaurant opening in the former Mandolin space in Raleigh's Five Points area, operated by Jalmex Hospitality. The restaurant will offer approximately 120 seats, a full bar and a Tulum-inspired interior design across roughly 4,400 square feet. The menu will feature authentic Mexican dishes and Tex-Mex offerings using higher-quality ingredients including outside skirt steak and fresh-squeezed juices for margaritas.

data.location: 11008 SE 66th Terrace, Belleview, FL 34420
data.status: targeting an opening in about 45 days
data.short_description: Monti Primo Ristorante is a modern Italian family-style restaurant opening in the former Tropical Vibes Restaurant and Bar space in Belleview, operated by Chef Mondi Markeci. The restaurant will seat approximately 150 guests inside, plus an event room for about 50 people, 13 bar seats and 12 to 16 outdoor seats. The menu will focus on fresh, made-in-house sauces and modern Italian dishes offered a la carte.

data.location: Service area: Broward, Miami-Dade and Palm Beach counties, South Florida
data.short_description: Twin Brothers Daiquiris is a Bahamas-based mobile daiquiri truck launching service across South Florida on June 1st, owned by Eric S. George and co-owner Denise Sanders. The truck will serve three frozen daiquiri flavors — strawberry, piña colada and Miami Vice — and will be available for private events, city events, school events and festivals. The brand originated at the Fish Fry area in Nassau, Bahamas, and George secured the recipe rights for the state of Florida.

data.location: 29602 Wesley Chapel Boulevard, Wesley Chapel, FL 33543
data.short_description: Guac & Roll is a Cuban-Mexican food truck with about 40 outdoor seats operated by Keilin Fernandez and Hector Ramirez, preparing to open a permanent location in Wesley Chapel. The menu features tacos, quesadillas, burritos, Latin Power rice bowls, sandwiches, Cuban sandwiches, whole fried fish, coffee, smoothies and natural juices. A stage for live music is being built on-site as part of the concept.

data.location: 220 N Pine St, Suite A, Charlotte, NC 28202
data.short_description: Karak House Coffee is opening its first North Carolina location in Charlotte's Uptown area, the brand's third location after Laguna Hills, California and New York. The approximately 2,000-square-foot shop will seat about 80 people and specialize in karak shots, a tea-based drink made with blends and evaporated milk, along with pastries. A defining feature of the brand is late evening operating hours, positioning it as a space to hang out or work after typical coffee shop hours.

data.location: 11500 Webb Bridge Way, Alpharetta, GA 30005
data.short_description: Locally family-owned upscale Italian restaurant inspired by Tuscan flavors from Florence, Italy. Will seat about 90 guests inside and 30 outdoors, with a full bar featuring Renaissance-inspired architecture. Menu highlights include pappardelle al ragù, pici cacio e pepe, and Florentine steak, with fresh pasta made in-house.

data.location: 160 Carl Eller Road, Mars Hill, NC 28754
data.short_description: New taproom and pizza-focused concept opening in a former garage with roughly 2,000 sq ft of space plus an outdoor music pavilion. Will feature 12–16 taps highlighting local and regional Western North Carolina breweries. Plans to host community events, trivia, game nights, and outdoor music.

The California-style fresh Mex restaurant will continue its counter-service format with the same menu made fresh daily. Timeline depends on construction, permitting, and equipment ordering.

data.short_description: Third metro Atlanta location for The Nest Cafe, planned within the Medley development in Johns Creek. Owner Jordan Segal confirmed the opening is tied to the broader Medley development's grand opening on October 29.

data.location: 112 Courtland St NE, Atlanta, GA 30303
data.short_description: Franchisee Amin Ferdowsi of MRCO is bringing the first Hawaiian Bros plate lunch restaurant to downtown Atlanta, targeting Q1 2027. MRCO operates approximately 90 Taco Bell restaurants and has an agreement to develop Hawaiian Bros locations in northern Alabama, western Georgia, and North Carolina. The menu features fresh chicken dishes, rice, and sides with no fryers, microwaves, or freezers on premise.

data.location: 395 E. 1st Ave., Hialeah, FL 33010
data.status: targeting an early to mid-June opening
data.short_description: Husband-and-wife owners Vladimir Sanchez and Maite Capote are opening a fresh Cuban cuisine restaurant in a former downtown Hialeah bakery space of approximately 1,500 sq ft. The menu will focus on fresh ingredients with no frozen food, featuring plantains, pork, and Cuban sandwiches, operating daily from 7 a.m. to 11 p.m.

data.location: 816 Duval Street, Key West, FL (zip code not specified)
data.short_description: Coastal Italian restaurant opened by owners Albena Pechakova and Michael Dana inside a restored conch house after approximately eight months of renovation. The menu is led by Rome-born executive chef Paolo Galotti and focuses on local ingredients through a coastal Italian lens, with in-house bread, pasta, sauces, and dressings. The restaurant's name means "conch" in Italian, connecting its Italian inspiration to Key West's Conch Republic identity.

data.location: Serving Duval, St. Johns, Nassau and Clay counties, FL (no fixed address — food trailer)
data.short_description: New food trailer from Kirk Lawler and his wife Janet Lawler, focused on fresh never-frozen Angus beef smash burgers and fries. The beef is sourced and ground daily by Tillman's Meat Shop in Jacksonville, with buns expected from Village Bakery in Jacksonville. A neighborhood soft opening is planned before the mid-June public launch.

data.location: 101 Palm Harbor Pkwy, Suites A101-102, Palm Coast, FL 32137 (European Village)
data.short_description: New upscale sports bar and restaurant from owners Chris Moore and Pamela Moore, who also own the Pelican Pub in St. Augustine. The 126-seat venue will feature a 10-screen video wall, live entertainment stage, and a menu combining traditional sports bar fare with premium rotating entrees.

data.short_description: New Mediterranean counter-service concept from owner Ezzat Abdelaty, featuring build-your-own bowls, wraps, and grilled proteins prepared in an open kitchen. The owner previously ran Golden Spoon Diner locations and intends Grill Bowl to be the first in a franchise brand.

data.location: 6205 FL 16, St. Augustine, FL 32092

data.short_description: Owner Jaimie Baptista is opening a second permanently parked coffee trailer with both a drive-thru and walk-up window, plus picnic and Adirondack-style seating. The trailer continues the business's retro teal-and-white theme and will serve craft espresso, cold brew, tea, chai, chillers, pastries, and breakfast sandwiches.
